business.description: Tarai Foods Limited is engaged in mushroom growing under controlled conditions and offers a range of Frozen and IQF (Individually Quick Frozen) products such as peas, fruits, and vegetables, as well as canned peas. The company did not carry on any business operations during the financial year 2025-26.

outlook.statement: Food Processing Industry is of enormous significance for India's development; growth potential is enormous and food production is expected to double in the next 5 years; consumption of value added food products will grow at a fast pace. Management is consistently keeping close watch on the changing market scenario and business strategy is reviewed regularly for achieving consistent growth.

The net worth of the company is negative as at the Balance Sheet date. However accounts of the company have been prepared on going concern basis since the company is taking necessary steps for its revival. In case the company is unable to continue as going concern in future, the resultant adjustments, if any are presently not ascertainable.
